parts.html: The K-07 kitchen is a white U-shaped model in a modern style: solid painted fronts and a porcelain stoneware countertop with a visible texture.
The furniture runs along three walls, so while you cook, the work surfaces, appliances, and cabinets are only a couple of steps away.
A U-shaped kitchen has a lot of cabinets, and the white color keeps them from crowding the room.
The kitchen is 6.9 linear meters long, which is enough for dishes, food, and utensils. There is a cargo pull-out.
The appliances are built in. There is no island, and the center of the room stays open.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
We will design the K-07 for your room, taking into account utility connections, appliances, windows, and doors, and organize the storage the way that suits you.
